key.name: show-drun-button
key.description: Whether to show the panel button that opens the app launcher overlay (AppSearchOverlay).

key.name: tooltip-font-size
key.description: Font size of the workspace name hint, pinned-app hover tooltip, and pinned-app drag insertion hint (points).

key.name: show-window-button
key.description: Whether to show the panel button that opens the all-windows search overlay (WindowSearchOverlay).

key.name: show-workspace-names
key.summary: Show workspace name label and drag-over hint
key.description: Whether to show the workspace name in the panel and as a hint while dragging a window over a thumbnail.

key.name: group-apps-always
key.summary: Always group windows by app in the panel
key.description: When enabled, every app with more than one window on a workspace collapses into a single badged icon. When disabled, grouping only engages when the panel runs out of horizontal room (the prototype's progressive collapse), or for workspaces above the direct-mode window threshold.

key.name: toolbar-icon-size
key.summary: Icon size for panel toolbar buttons
key.description: Size of the 'apps' and 'all windows' button icons in the panel (pixels).

key.name: icon-size
key.summary: Default icon size for window previews
key.description: Size of each window icon in the workspace thumbnails (pixels). When app grouping engages, icons fall back to a denser ceiling so badged groups still fit.

key.name: thumbnail-min-width
key.summary: Minimum width of each workspace thumbnail
key.description: Minimum width of each workspace thumbnail in the panel (pixels).

key.name: workspace-name-font-size
key.summary: Font size of the workspace name label
key.description: Font size of the workspace name displayed in the panel (pixels).

key.name: hover-preview-height
key.summary: Height of the hover preview window clone
key.description: Height of the live preview shown when hovering over a window icon (pixels).

key.name: close-button-size
key.summary: Size of the close button on previews
key.description: Size of the close button icon on previews (pixels).
